crosshair.caveat: Absence of a counterexample is NOT a proof. Result is consistent with the identity derivation; the bool domain is exhaustively {False, True} so the contract holds by inspection as well.

classification_rationale: Tractable bare-boolean predicate over a single public YAML input (GlobalParameters.EnableAsserts). z3 proves BOTH polarities satisfiable; Python confirms branch_taken == self.enableAsserts == EnableAsserts. Unlike self.do["PreLoop"] (pinned to a True singleton at __init__), EnableAsserts is genuinely user-configurable (default False, set True via YAML), so both branches are reachable at runtime through public input. Hence fully-static, not solver-backed-under-assumptions.
